SELECT t.distributor_code, f.task_group, g.running_type, g.should_exec_time, g.alarm_time, i.task_id, i.task_name, i.moduleid, i.task_type, i.can_again, s.pre_task_id, s.exec_order, s.task_params, s.simple_flow, i.service_class, i.req_class, i.in_class, s.distributor_batch FROM ta_clear_group_member f LEFT JOIN kbatch_group_info g ON g.task_group = f.task_group LEFT JOIN ta_distributor_info t ON f.group_member = t.distributor_code LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_set s ON f.task_group = s.task_group LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_info i ON s.task_id = i.task_id WHERE i.moduleid = :moduleid AND s.moduleid = :moduleid AND f.exec_task_type in (:task_type_imp, :task_type_exp) AND t.status = '1' AND t.distributor_type = '1' AND t.data_status = 'E' ORDER BY s.exec_order

SELECT t.file_type, g.task_group, g.running_type, g.should_exec_time, g.alarm_time, i.task_id, i.task_name, i.moduleid, i.task_type, i.can_again, s.pre_task_id, s.exec_order, s.task_params, s.simple_flow, i.service_class, i.req_class, i.in_class FROM ta_clear_group_member f LEFT JOIN kbatch_group_info g ON g.task_group = f.task_group LEFT JOIN ta_intf_file_manage t ON f.group_member=t.file_type LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_set s ON f.task_group=s.task_group LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_info i ON s.task_id = i.task_id WHERE i.moduleid = :moduleid AND i.task_type = :task_type AND t.status = '1' ORDER BY s.exec_order

SELECT p.prod_mode, p.prod_code, s.task_group, g.running_type, g.should_exec_time, g.alarm_time, i.task_id, i.task_name, i.moduleid, i.task_type, i.can_again, s.pre_task_id, s.exec_order, s.task_params, s.simple_flow, i.service_class, i.req_class, i.in_class FROM ta_prod_info p LEFT JOIN ta_prod_task_set s ON p.batch_mode = s.batch_mode LEFT JOIN kbatch_group_info g ON g.task_group = s.task_group LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_info i ON s.task_id = i.task_id LEFT JOIN ta_prod_period tpp ON tpp.prod_code = p.prod_code WHERE g.exec_task_type=:exec_task_type AND s.moduleid = :moduleid AND i.task_id IS NOT NULL AND i.moduleid = :moduleid AND p.data_status = :data_status AND tpp.data_status = 'E' AND (p.prod_lifecycle IN ('2','4','5','6','7','3') OR (p.prod_lifecycle ='8' AND winding_date=:work_date))
AND p.prod_mode = :prod_mode
ORDER BY s.exec_order

SELECT dis.task_group, dis.task_id, dis.target_code, dis.prod_code, i.task_type FROM kbatch_task_exec_display dis LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_exec exec ON exec.task_execid = dis.task_execid LEFT JOIN kbatch_task_info i ON dis.task_id = i.task_id WHERE i.moduleid = :moduleid AND dis.moduleid = :moduleid AND dis.task_date = :task_date AND (dis.is_exec = :is_exec AND dis.exec_status NOT IN (:exec_status_skip, :exec_status_termination) AND (exec.exec_status IS NULL OR exec.exec_status NOT IN (:exec_status_success, :exec_status_skip, :exec_status_termination)))
